meta.title: feat: optimize calendar cache retrieval with CachedCalendarService
meta.body_summary: Add CachedCalendarService with in-memory cache to reduce database and Google Calendar API calls during booking.

perf_labels.notes: Devin created CachedCalendarService but received no review; PR auto-closed after ~10 days of inactivity with no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 285 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, concentrated in new cache service files. As a moderate incremental performance PR it was closed without merge due to inactivity, not technical rejection.

core_change_summary.description: Added CachedCalendarService implementing Calendar interface with in-memory store to cache availability during booking; integrated into handleNewBooking to fetch all selected calendars at once and clear cache; modified getCalendarsEvents to use cached service when available.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Remaining files are modifications to booking flow and repository to integrate cache; minimal deletions indicate mostly additive changes.
